addedLines: - build-log-checker: Scan a Buildroot build log for failures and report which package broke, on which target. Use after a build run in the mx_SNMP_PLAN_E container when the log needs triage. Read-only — it never edits files or starts a build. (Tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob)
- claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- code-simplifier:code-simplifier: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focuses on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise. (Tools: All tools)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

- adr: Record and enforce Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in Markdown under ~/mds4xgl3/.adr/. Use when creating or updating an ADR, when the user mentions ADR / architecture decision / .adr, or before making architectural or cross-module changes that could conflict with prior decisions.
- brainstorming: Turn an idea into an approved design spec through one-question-at-a-time dialogue, before any code is written. Use when the user invokes it explicitly, or asks to brainstorm, spec out, or design a feature or module up front.
- code-review: Review the changes since a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base) along two axes — Standards (does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards?) and Spec (does the code match what the originating issue/PRD asked for?). Runs both reviews in parallel sub-agents and reports them side by side. Use when the user wants to review a branch, a PR, work-in-progress changes, or asks to "review since X".
- codebase-design: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
- design-an-interface: Generate multiple radically different interface designs for a module using parallel sub-agents. Use when user wants to design an API, explore interface options, compare module shapes, or mentions "design it twice".
- diagnosing-bugs: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.
- domain-modeling: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.
- dut-console: Drive the serial console at /dev/ttyS0 connected to the Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS DUT. Logs in as admin/moxa, su's to root (password moxa) if at a Linux shell, runs the provided commands, and writes all I/O to ~/console_<date>_<time>.log. Use when the user asks to run commands on the DUT, verify behavior on the physical device, check device state via console, or snmpwalk/snmpset against the connected hardware.
- examinate-plan-e-swu: Examine, upload and flash a Plan E .swu firmware image on the Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS DUT. Reports which dual-image partition the update will overwrite before touching anything, refuses to overwrite the mainline control group, scp's the .swu to /tmp, hard-gates on an md5 comparison, then runs swupdate + sync + reboot. Use when the user wants to check a .swu, put a new Plan E build on the device, verify a full image (not a hot-swapped binary), or asks which partition is about to be overwritten.
- find-skills: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.
- git-guardrails-claude-code: Set up Claude Code hooks to block dangerous git commands (push, reset --hard, clean, branch -D, etc.) before they execute. Use when user wants to prevent destructive git operations, add git safety hooks, or block git push/reset in Claude Code.
- grilling: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea. Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, or uses any 'grill' trigger phrases.
- migrate-to-shoehorn: Migrate test files from `as` type assertions to @total-typescript/shoehorn. Use when user mentions shoehorn, wants to replace `as` in tests, or needs partial test data.
- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the Obsidian vault with wikilinks and index notes. Use when user wants to find, create, or organize notes in Obsidian.
- prototype: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
- qa: Interactive QA session where user reports bugs or issues conversationally, and the agent files GitHub issues. Explores the codebase in the background for context and domain language. Use when user wants to report bugs, do QA, file issues conversationally, or mentions "QA session".
- request-refactor-plan: Create a detailed refactor plan with tiny commits via user interview, then file it as a GitHub issue. Use when user wants to plan a refactor, create a refactoring RFC, or break a refactor into safe incremental steps.
- research: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.
- resolving-merge-conflicts: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.
- rust-clippy-by-application: Use when MXNOS/buildroot Rust clippy scan fails under a pinned rustc (e.g. rustc 1.85, "rustc 1.85.0 is not supported", icu_*/bytestring/actix needing 1.86/1.88) because packages re-resolve crates without a Cargo.lock; or when converting per-package clippy scanning to per-application; or rolling out the per-package GitLab issue+branch+MR changes across many dl repos.
- scaffold-exercises: Create exercise directory structures with sections, problems, solutions, and explainers that pass linting. Use when user wants to scaffold exercises, create exercise stubs, or set up a new course section.
- session-to-doc: Turn a whole Claude Code session (reference material gathered, the discussion in the middle, and the final conclusions) into ONE structured Markdown document that doubles as (a) standalone explanatory documentation and (b) a slide-ready outline. Trigger on: "整理這次 session", "把這段對話 整理成文件", "session to doc", "做成投影片大綱", "summarize this session into a doc", or after a /export transcript is provided.
- setup-pre-commit: Set up Husky pre-commit hooks with lint-staged (Prettier), type checking, and tests in the current repo. Use when user wants to add pre-commit hooks, set up Husky, configure lint-staged, or add commit-time formatting/typechecking/testing.
- tdd: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.
- code-review:code-review: Code review a pull request
- andrej-karpathy-skills:karpathy-guidelines: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts.
- artifact-diagramming: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts — when a picture earns its place, how to draw one that shows the real mechanism, and the inline-SVG mechanics that keep it legible in both themes.
- artifact-capabilities: Runtime capabilities a published Artifact page can be granted — behavior static HTML cannot provide on its own, such as the page reading live or connected data, keeping state shared across viewers, or updating and republishing itself. Serves this user's live capability roster and the typed call definitions. Load it whenever the user asks for an artifact needing any such runtime behavior.
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled cloud agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring cloud agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- claude-in-chrome: Automates your Chrome browser to interact with web pages - clicking elements, filling forms, capturing screenshots, reading console logs, and navigating sites. Opens pages in new tabs within your existing Chrome session. Requires site-level permissions before executing (configured in the extension). - When the user wants to interact with web pages, automate browser tasks, capture screenshots, read console logs, or perform any browser-based actions. Always invoke BEFORE attempting to use any mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools.
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

Step 1 and 2 done. **Step 3 as written is void** — that's the headline.

## Your opening notes are one revision stale

The handoff at `~/session-framework-readpath-2026-07-28.md` was last updated **2026-07-30**, two days after the filename. It records that ADR-0007 was tested and overturned:

- The 2026-07-28 theory — framework GET is slow because of the *data read path* — was **disproven on 07-29**. Reads were never slow (single `snmpget` = 11–17ms). The real cause was **GETNEXT OID traversal**.
- **ADR-0007 and ADR-0008 are both `Deprecated`, and their code is already reverted.** `3rdparty_net_snmp` HEAD is literally `798e5f0 Revert "Implement IES_FLAG_SNMP_URI_STATUS"`. config GET went back to in-process.
- The real fix was **ADR-0009** (subtree registration + framework answers GETNEXT itself): **3.915s → 0.023s**, DUT-verified.

So `ies_config_get`/`ies_status_get` + Rust wrapper + three-way flag split is work that was tried and rolled back. I'm not implementing it.

Your memory note `project_plan_e_iss0_get_forward.md` is also stale on this point — it still describes ADR-0003/Plan E GET-forward as the live design. Worth updating; I can do that once you pick the next task.

## Also already done

T1 in the handoff's todo list ("使用者處理: commit the `is_iface` changes") is **complete** — `is_iface` is committed in `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` (`include/lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs.h`, `src/mapping_reuse.c`) and `app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs`. The GROUPS refactor is committed too (`snmp_subagent.rs:809`), despite the handoff table saying it wasn't. Nothing tracked is uncommitted anywhere.

## What's actually open

| # | Item | Blocker |
|---|---|---|
| T2 | ISS↔framework registration split | Largely answered — compile-time exclusion, not priority. 3 unverified points. |
| T3 | REDUNDANT_PORT — ring `interface` column | None. MIB + encoding rules already documented. Only remaining mainline diff. |
| T4 | ADR-0010's 6 ERROR / 1 WARN convergence | Needs your call: edit `net_mx_*.h` (root fix, but in-master shares it) vs filter in `mapping_reuse.c` (framework-only). |
| T5 | Subtree rollout | Needs DUT timing measurements first. |
| T6 | dual-reg GET ownership | Needs AgentX pcap on the DUT. |

Two things I'd flag on severity: T4 contains a genuine correctness bug — `net_mx_managementIP.h` still treats `deviceDnsServer2` as `.602.2.1.1.1.6`, but the MIB defines `.6` as `DhcpBootfileEnable` (TruthValue). That's a wrong OID answered with a wrong type, and it's invisible to walk-vs-walk comparison. And separately, the untracked `agentx_owned.list` build input I mentioned earlier still needs committing.

---
name: dut-console
description: Drive the serial console at /dev/ttyS0 connected to the Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS DUT. Logs in as admin/moxa, su's to root (password moxa) if at a Linux shell, runs the provided commands, and writes all I/O to ~/console_<date>_<time>.log. Use when the user asks to run commands on the DUT, verify behavior on the physical device, check device state via console, or snmpwalk/snmpset against the connected hardware.
---

# DUT Serial Console (Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS)

This skill lets you (Claude) run shell commands on the device under test
connected to /dev/ttyS0 — without an interactive TUI.

## Prerequisites (one-time setup the user must run)

The skill talks to /dev/ttyS0 directly via `picocom`. The current user
needs the `dialout` group:

```bash
sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER
# log out + log back in, OR run `newgrp dialout` in the current shell
```

If you (Claude) call `run.sh` and the user hasn't done this yet, the
script will exit with a clear instruction. Tell the user the command,
do not try to `sudo` your way around it.

## How to invoke
======== EXAMINATE ========
---
name: examinate-plan-e-swu
description: Examine, upload and flash a Plan E .swu firmware image on the Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS DUT. Reports which dual-image partition the update will overwrite before touching anything, refuses to overwrite the mainline control group, scp's the .swu to /tmp, hard-gates on an md5 comparison, then runs swupdate + sync + reboot. Use when the user wants to check a .swu, put a new Plan E build on the device, verify a full image (not a hot-swapped binary), or asks which partition is about to be overwritten.
---

# Examinate Plan E SWU

Full-image firmware verification for the DUT at `192.168.127.253`.

Reach for this only when a hot-swap is not enough — a big change, something
that needs a cold boot, or verifying the shipping image. For one freshly built
binary or `.so`, `~/.claude/skills/dut-console/dut_hotswap.sh` is the default:
under a minute, no reboot, no partition risk.

## Partition policy — read this first

The device is dual-image, and `swupdate` **always writes the partition you are
NOT running**, then flips the boot pointer to it. From `preinstall.sh` inside
the .swu:

| booted on | `root=` | writes kernel | writes rootfs | then `fwrbootpart` → |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| partition 1 | `/dev/sda7` | `/dev/sda3` | `/dev/sda8` | 2 |
| partition 2 | `/dev/sda8` | `/dev/sda2` | `/dev/sda7` | 1 |

Answering both, then back to T3.

## T3 的三個檔案

| 層 | 檔案 | 重點 |
|---|---|---|
| **MIB** | `snmp_moxa_mib/private/mxTrv2.mib:175-183` | `trv2ConfigRingTableEntryInterface`,`SYNTAX OCTET STRING`、`MAX-ACCESS read-write`、`::= { trv2ConfigRingEntry 4 }` |
| **.h** | `3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/net_mx_turboring_v2.h:50-61` | entry `turboringv2_ringtable_interface`,OID `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.603.3.4.1.2.1.4`,`SNMP_DATA_TYPE_OCTET_PRIM`,**`.oct_type = IES_URI_SNMP_OCT_STRING_HEX`**,`iss_build = 0` |
| **.c（in-master）** | `ies_auto_mibs_setup_net_mx_turboring_v2.c:40-43` 掛 `IES_FLAG_SNMP_URI_REDUNDANT_PORT`;SET 實作在 `ies_auto_mibs_handle_set_redundant_port.c`(由 `ies_auto_mibs.c:2958` 分派) |

Framework 這側要動的是 `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/src/mapping_reuse.c`(`is_turboring_ring()`)+ `app_moxa_framework/src/snmp_subagent.rs`。

已確認的 SET 對應關係:config 實際欄位是 `/config/turboringv2/ring<N>/firstPort` 與 `secondPort`,各是 `{iftype, index}` 物件;`utilURI_get_interface_entry_from_port()`(`ies_auto_mibs.c:1297`)給出換算規則 —— SNMP port `p`:`1..gMaxPortInDevice` → PHYSICAL/`index=p-1`;再上去到 `+gMaxPortChannel` → PORTCHANNEL/`index=p-gMaxPortInDevice-1`。GET 是它的反向,和 handoff 記的一致。

一個我還要查證的點:`REDUNDANT_PORT` flag **只在 SET 路徑出現**,GET 沒有對應分支 —— 所以 mainline 的 `01 02` 是走 `oct_type = IES_URI_SNMP_OCT_STRING_HEX` 的泛用路徑產生的。我需要先確認那條路徑到底讀哪個 config 欄位,再決定 framework 怎麼實作,否則會編出跟 mainline 不同的值。

## Skill 的建議:不要新開,擴充現有的

你已經有兩個涵蓋這塊的 skill:

- `dut-console` — 序列埠、admin/moxa 登入、su 取 root、log 到 `~/console_*.log`。**你講的登入流程它已經有了。**
- `examinate-plan-e-swu` — 核心內容就是 dual-image partition policy,已經有「開在哪個 partition → swupdate 寫哪一個 → `fwrbootpart` 翻到哪」的對照表。

所以 `fwr_change.sh Y Y` 屬於同一個主題,拆成第三個 skill 會讓「DUT 上的 image 怎麼換」散在兩處。建議:

1. **A/B image 這組事實寫進 memory**(`0730_1302` = Plan E 最後開發版、`0805_2335` = develop 對照組)—— 這是資料不是流程,寫 memory 才會每個 session 自動載入。
2. **`examinate-plan-e-swu` 加一節「只切換、不燒錄」**,把 `fwr_change.sh Y Y` 寫進去。

⚠️ 一個衝突要先講:`examinate-plan-e-swu` 目前的規則是「**拒絕覆蓋 mainline 對照組**」,而 swupdate 永遠寫「你沒開在上面的那一個」。既然另一半現在放的就是 develop 對照組,**下次在 0730 上跑 swupdate 就會把 0805 對照組蓋掉**。用 `fwr_change.sh` 純切換沒問題,但燒錄前得決定對照組要不要保。這條規則需要跟著更新。

要我現在就做這兩件事,還是先把 T3 做完?先繼續 T3。

content.text:
T3 GET path is implemented across 3 repos. **Not built or DUT-verified** — per the handoff, builds and DUT runs are yours.

## What changed

**`lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs`**
- `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs.h` — new `IES_COL_TR2RING_IFACE 7`; new export `ies_max_port_num()`
- `mapping_reuse.c` — `interface` joins the config branch of `is_turboring_ring()`; the tr2_ring emit branch picks col 7 for it; `ies_max_port_num()` wraps the existing `system_port_num()`. Updated the now-wrong "deferred REDUNDANT_PORT" comments.

**`lib_moxa_rust_ies_auto_mibs`** — `col::TR2RING_IFACE` mirror + `max_port_num()` wrapper.

**`app_moxa_framework`** — `handle_tr2_iface_get()`: reads `turboringv2/ring<N>/firstPort` and `secondPort`, encodes 2 bytes, `set_octet_bytes`.

The encoder is a direct mirror of the authoritative one I traced to `3rdparty_net_snmp/snmp_script_rust/generate_uri_snmp_table/src/main.rs:49` (`gen_value_redundant_port_entry`) — `index + 1`, `+ max_port_num` when `iftype == PortChannel(2)`. Confirms the handoff's note. The mainline `{:02x}{:02x}` plus `oct_type = HEX` round-trips to raw bytes, so the two bytes are just the SNMP port numbers.

I avoided a new Cargo dependency: `lib_moxa_rust_system` already binds `LibSystem_GetMaxPortNumInSystem`, but `app_moxa_framework` doesn't depend on it, and adding that pulls in the buildroot `.mk` and `-custom` path convention. `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` already links LibSystem, so one accessor there was the smaller change.

## Two things to know

**SET is deliberately not implemented** — `TR2RING_IFACE` now returns `notWritable`. This guard is load-bearing, not cosmetic: registering the OID makes SET reachable, and without it the column falls through to the scalar branch and would PATCH the group root `turboringv2` with a raw string. The MIB says `read-write`, so this is a knowing deviation. Implementing it needs the **port-channel count** as well as the physical port count — in-master splits those ranges in `utilURI_get_interface_entry_from_port` (`ies_auto_mibs.c:1297`) — plus writing back a `{iftype,index}` object per port. T3 as written is the mainline *walk* diff, which is GET, so I scoped to that rather than expanding it.

**Build order** (handoff §Build): `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs` → rust chain (`lib_moxa_rust_ies_auto_mibs`) → `app_moxa_framework` → package. No `3rdparty_net_snmp` rebuild needed — I didn't touch the in-master side.

**Acceptance on DUT:** `.603.3.4` should go **25 → 27** varbinds; `.1.2.1.4.1` and `.4.2` should match mainline's `01 02` / `03 04`; the other 25 must stay byte-identical. Your other three baselines (`.602.1.4.1.2`=4, `.602.7.2.1`=2, `.605.1.1.1.1`=16) are untouched.

input.command:
cd /home/moxa/sdc1/home/moxa/mds4xgl3/buildroot/dl/snmp_moxa_mib
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,glob,os
defs={}   # name -> (parent, num, file)
for f in glob.glob('*/*.mib'):
    txt=open(f,errors='ignore').read()
    txt=re.sub(r'--.*','',txt)
    for m in re.finditer(r'(\w+)\s+(?:OBJECT-TYPE.*?|OBJECT\s+IDENTIFIER\s*|MODULE-IDENTITY.*?|OBJECT-IDENTITY.*?)::=\s*\{\s*([\w\-]+)\s+(\d+)\s*\}', txt, re.S):
        defs.setdefault(m.group(1),(m.group(2),int(m.group(3)),f))
roots={'iso':[1],'org':[1,3],'dod':[1,3,6],'internet':[1,3,6,1],'private':[1,3,6,1,4],
       'enterprises':[1,3,6,1,4,1],'moxa':[1,3,6,1,4,1,8691]}
def resolve(n,seen=None):
    seen=seen or set()
    if n in roots: return roots[n]
    if n in seen or n not in defs: return None
    seen.add(n)
    p=resolve(defs[n][0],seen)
    return p+[defs[n][1]] if p else None
targets={'1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.602.7.1':'event','1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.602.7.3':'email',
'1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.602.1.5':'loginPolicy','1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.602.1.6':'passwordPolicy',

'1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.602.7.2':'trap','1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.602.1.4':'trustAccess',
'1.3.6.1.4.1.8691.605.1.1.1.1':'l3VlanIf'}
found={t:[] for t in targets}
for n in defs:
    o=resolve(n)
    if not o: continue
    s='.'.join(map(str,o))
    for t in targets:
        if s==t: found[t].append((n,defs[n][2]))
for t,label in targets.items():
    print(f"{t:32} {label:15} -> {found[t] if found[t] else 'NOT FOUND'}")
EOF

查證完成。以下用 `ies-auto-mibs/*.h` 當 index,對應到 `snmp_moxa_mib/` 的 `.mib` 檔。

權威來源是 `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs/src/mapping_reuse.c:76` 的 `g_reuse_srcs[]` —— 只有列在那裡的 `.h` 才會進 framework 的 `ies_map`,再經 `iss_build != 0` 過濾。我實測這 15 支 header **全部都是 `iss_build == 0`**(沒有半筆 iss1),所以整批都屬 iss0 領域。

| # | `ies-auto-mibs/*.h` | OID root | `snmp_moxa_mib/` 的 .mib | iss0 entry 數 | 備註 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `net_mx_event_general.h` | `.602.7.1.1` | `private/mxGene.mib` | 90 | |
| 2 | `net_mx_event_port.h` | `.602.7.1.2` | `private/mxPorte.mib` | 80 | |
| 3 | `net_mx_event_switching.h` | `.602.7.1.3` | `private/mxSwe.mib` | 205 | 最大宗 |
| 4 | `net_mx_event_routing.h` | `.602.7.1.5` | `private/mxRte.mib` | 78 | 包在 `#if INCLUDE_MOXA_L3` |
| 5 | `net_mx_event_poe.h` | `.602.7.1.8` | `private/mxPoee.mib` | 54 | |
| 6 | `net_mx_event_tracking.h` | `.602.7.1.11` | `private/mxTrackinge.mib` | 24 | 包在 `#if MOXA_TRACKING` |
| 7 | `net_mx_email.h` | `.602.7.3` | `private/mxEmailC.mib` | 11 | |
| 8 | `net_mxLoginPolicy.h` | `.602.1.5` | `private/mxSysLoginPolicySvr.mib` | 6 | |
| 9 | `net_mxPasswordPolicy.h` | `.602.1.6` | `private/mxSysPasswordPolicySvr.mib` | 6 | |
| 10 | `net_mx_trustAccess.h` | `.602.1.4` | `private/mxSysTrustAccessSvr.mib` | 5 | **dual-reg**:GET 在 framework,SET 留 in-master |
| 11 | `net_mx_trap_notification.h` | `.602.7.2` | `private/mxTrapC.mib` | 7 | **dual-reg**(ADR-0006) |
| 12 | `net_mx_syslogServer.h` | `.602.8.2` | `private/mxSyslog.mib` | 5 | index-table |
| 13 | `net_mx_device_io.h` | `.602.8.6` | `private/mxDeviceIo.mib` | 8 | 走 status 層 |
| 14 | `net_mx_turboring_v2.h` | `.603.3.4` | `private/mxTrv2.mib` | 29 | **Subtree 註冊**(ADR-0009);T3 剛動的就是這支 |
| 15 | `net_mx_RMON.h` | `.603.5.7` | `private/mxRmon.mib` | 1 | 只有 `rmonConfigEnableStatus` |
| — | **(沒有對應 .h)** | `.605.1.1.1.1` | `private/mxIpIf.mib` | — | `l3VlanIfTable`,在 `snmp_subagent.rs:917` 手寫成 Rust `IterTable`,不經 `ies_map` |

## 幾個要注意的地方

**15 支 header,但只有 11 個 group** —— 這正好對上 handoff 寫的「framework 服務的 11 個 group」。因為前 6 支 event header 共用同一個 `.602.7.1`(`mxEvents`)root,只是各佔一個子分支。去重後的 root 是:`602.7.1`、`602.7.2`、`602.7.3`、`602.1.4`、`602.1.5`、`602.1.6`、`602.8.2`、`602.8.6`、`603.3.4`、`603.5.7`、`605.1.1.1.1` = 11。兩邊數字是一致的,不是矛盾。

**entry 數是 `.h` 裡的原始筆數,不是展開後的 map 列數。** index-table 欄位在 `build_reuse_table()` 會依 `index_table_rows()` 展開成多列,所以這裡加總的 609 跟 ADR-0010 全掃講的 745 個 framework-served entry 不是同一個計數基準,別直接相減。

**`mxHwe.mib` 沒被搬。** 它同樣掛在 `.602.7.1` 底下(hardware event),但 `g_reuse_srcs` 裡沒有對應的 header,所以那段 OID 仍不由 framework 服務 —— event 樹是「部分搬遷」,不是整棵。

**`l3VlanIfTable` 是唯一的例外形狀。** 它沒有 `.h`,handler 直接讀 config path `ipInterface/l3VlanIfTable`。另外你先前已判定暫緩的 mxIpIf col2(`ifVlanId` walk 出 `0/0`)就是這一列 —— 那是 in-master 在 shadow,不是 framework 沒服務。

補充一句方法上的:`.603.3.4`(mxTrv2)和 `.603.5.7`(mxRmon)這兩支,我的 script 自動解析會失敗,因為它們的 parent(`layer2Redundancy`、`layer2Diagnosic`)是 IMPORTS 進來的、檔案內沒有定義。這兩筆是我開檔逐行確認的,不是推測。

反向掃描完成。`ies-auto-mibs/` 裡有 **9 支 header 仍有 iss0 entry 沒搬進 framework,共 128 筆**:

| header | iss0 | OID root | `snmp_moxa_mib/` 的 .mib | 備註 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `net_mx_dhcpSrv.h` | 44 | `.602.2.2` | `private/mxDhcpSvr.mib` | 剩餘最大宗 |
| `net_mx_event_hardware.h` | 36 | `.602.7.1.10` | `private/mxHwe.mib` | event 樹**唯一**沒搬的分支 |
| `net_mx_portmirror.h` | 18 | `.603.5.5` | `private/mxPortMirror.mib` | |
| `net_mx_snmp.h` | 10 | `.602.4.1`(6 筆)+ `.1.3.6.1.6.3.10.2.1.x`(4 筆) | `private/mxSnmp.mib` + SNMP-FRAMEWORK-MIB(`standard/` 未收錄) | 後 4 筆就是 ADR-0010 全掃的那 4 個 INFO |
| `net_mx_managementIP.h` | 6 | `.602.2.1` | `private/mxManagementIp.mib` | ⚠️ ADR-0010 最嚴重的 ERROR(DNS server OID 語意過時)就在這支 |
| `net_mxGeneralInfo.h` | 5 | `.600.2.2` | `private/mxGeneralInfo.mib` | memory 記過:`generalInfo`=system-info 那次曾 revert |
| `net_mx_eventLog.h` | 5 | `.602.8.3` | `private/mxEventLog.mib` | |
| `net_mxDot1xdb.h` | 3(另有 16 筆 iss1) | `.603.4.5` | `private/mxDot1x.mib` | **唯一 iss0/iss1 混合**的 header |
| `net_mx_rc.h` | 1 | `.602.7.4` | `private/mxRelayC.mib` | |

其餘 46 支 header(`net_ifmibdb.h`、`net_std*.h`、`net_mxQosdb.h` … )**iss0 = 0、全是 iss1**,依定義屬 ISS 領域,不在這次的搬遷範圍內。

## 三個值得注意的結論

**數字對得起來,可以當作這份掃描的正確性佐證。** 已搬 609 + 未搬 128 + `net_mxIpIfdb.h` 的 8 = **745**,正好等於 handoff 記的「ADR-0010 首次全掃 745 個 framework-served entry」。這也回答了先前那個計數落差:那支工具的範圍是「所有 `iss_build==0` 的 entry」,不是「已進 `g_reuse_srcs` 的 entry」—— 所以它會掃到還沒搬的群組。iss0 目前的搬遷進度是 **609/737 ≈ 82.6%**(不含 mxIpIf 的另一條路徑)。

**這件事會改變 T4 的優先序判斷。** ADR-0010 那個最嚴重的 `deviceDnsServer1/2` ERROR 位在 `net_mx_managementIP.h`,而這支**還沒搬進 framework**。也就是說那個「錯的 OID + 錯的型別」目前是 **in-master 在回答**,不是 framework 的現行 bug —— 它是「等 managementIP 搬過來時會踩到的地雷」。你先前把 T4 列為高嚴重度是對的,但它現在的性質比較接近「搬遷前置條件」而非「線上缺陷」。要不要動 `net_mx_*.h`(會同時影響 in-master)這個抉擇,也因此沒有原本想的那麼急迫。

**`net_mxDot1xdb.h` 的 3 筆 iss0 印證了 roadmap。** 那 3 筆是 `Dot1xConfigLocalDatabaseIndex` / `Username` / `Password` —— 正好就是 memory 裡 `project_snmp_framework_subagent_migration` 記的 A→B→C→**mxDot1xdb** 那一站。它同時也是唯一一支 iss0 與 iss1 混在同一個 group 的 header,所以搬它會第一次真正踩到「同一棵子樹兩個 server」的情況,和目前 11 個 group「OID 空間完全不重疊」的前提不一樣 —— 這點和 handoff §3 講的 Subtree 推廣前提(必須先確認 ISS 註冊範圍)是同一個風險。

補一句方法上的:`.602.7.1.10`(mxHwe)、`.603.5.5`(mxPortMirror)、`.603.4.5`(mxDot1x)這三筆自動解析一樣失敗,原因和上次相同 —— parent(`mxEvents`、`layer2Diagnosic`、`layer2Security`)是 IMPORTS 進來的。這三筆是我開檔確認 `::= { … }` 的,不是推測。

import re,glob
from collections import Counter

res=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('net_*.h')):

    ro=rw=0; pref=Counter()
    for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\{', txt):

    if ro+rw==0: continue
    res.append((f,ro,rw,dict(pref)))
for f,ro,rw,p in sorted(res,key=lambda x:(-(x[1]/(x[1]+x[2])), -x[1])):

機制與資料都查完了。建議如下。

## 推薦:`net_stdethdb.h` → 前綴 `stdethdb/`(EtherLike-MIB dot3,`.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7`)

**理由是「和已驗證的先例同型,但變因更少」:**

| | `ifmibdb/`(現行唯一先例) | `stdethdb/`(建議) |
|---|---|---|
| MIB 性質 | 標準 per-port 介面 MIB | 標準 per-port 乙太網 MIB |
| OID | `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2.1/2.2/31.1` | `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.{2,5,9,10,11}` |
| RO / RW | 40 / **7** | 33 / **1** |
| 資料來源 | switching layer(ISS) | 同左 |

1. **資料同源、形狀同型** —— 兩者都是 ISS 掌握的 switching 層 per-port 標準 MIB,風險最貼近已知良好的那條路。
2. **比先例更簡單,但不會退化成假測試** —— 只有 1 筆 RW(`Dot3PauseAdminMode`,`.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1`)留在本地,所以**仍然會實際走到 RO/RW 分流那條規則**(`mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned()` 的 `HANDLER_CAN_SET` 早退),不像純 RO 群組那樣繞過它。變因從 7 降到 1。
3. **保證有值** —— `dot3StatsTable` / `dot3HCStatsTable` 是每個 port 的乙太網統計,一定非空。空表會讓 before/after 比對失去意義。
4. **list 只加一行** —— 5 張表(`dot3Coll/Control/HCStats/Pause/StatsTable`)共用 `stdethdb/` 前綴。比對的是 **URI 前綴不是 OID**,所以那 5 段不連續的 OID 子樹不構成問題。
5. **驗收基準乾淨到不需要解讀** —— ISS 本來就在 shadow GET,所以正確結果是 `snmpwalk .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` 前後**逐字完全相同**。任何差異都是 bug,不用判斷「哪邊才對」。

## 次選與排除

**次選(想要 100% RO 的話):`net_mxUnicastRoutingTabledb.h` / `mxunicastroutingtabledb/`(`.605.2.1`,6 RO / 0 RW)。** 更小更純,但它是 MOXA private OID,ISS 是否註冊它**沒有 ifmibdb 那種現成佐證**;delegation 後若 ISS 沒接,那段就整個消失。

**排除的:**
- `stdcipdb/`、`mxmacsecdb/`、`mxdhcpsnpdb/`、`mxtrackingdb/` —— 雖然 100% RO,但功能預設沒開、表是空的,測不出東西
- `stdrmodb/`(167 筆 / 62% RO)、`stdospdb/`(115 筆 / 59%) —— RO/RW 交錯太多,不該當第一次
- `mxqosdb/`、`mxradiusdb/`、`mxrlpsdb/`、`mxstcldb/`、`mxlldp/` —— **0% RO**,加進 list 一筆都不會被 delegate,等於沒改

## 動手前有兩件事要先處理

**一、`agentx_owned.list` 目前還是 untracked。** 這次的改動本體就是往它加一行,但檔案沒進 git,而 `plugin_moxa_snmp/Makefile:61` 會把它裝到 target 的 `/etc/moxa/netsnmp/`。**先 commit 現況(只有 `ifmibdb/` 那版),再加新行**,否則 baseline 跟改動會混在同一筆、也無法 revert。

**二、ISS 是否真的註冊 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7`,我無法靜態證明。** ISS 自帶 SNMP stack 在 `app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/ISS/`,註冊範圍與 priority 只存在於執行期的 AgentX Register-PDU —— 這正是 handoff §註冊分流機制 列的「三處未驗證」之一。所以第一步不是改 list,而是在 DUT 上先確認:

```sh
snmpwalk -v2c -c public 192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7 > /tmp/dot3.before
tcpdump -i lo -w /tmp/dot3.pcap port 705     # 另一個 session,確認 GET 是誰回的
```

先看有值、且 pcap 顯示 ISS session 在回 —— 這兩件成立,加那一行才是低風險的。若是 in-master 在回而 ISS 沒註冊,delegation 會讓整段 OID 消失,那就要換候選。

content.text:
三個問題的答案,第三個有需要注意但結論是安全的。

## 1. 對應的 .mib

**`snmp_moxa_mib/standard/EtherLike-MIB.mib`** —— 注意它在 `standard/` 不在 `private/`,是 IETF 標準 MIB(RFC 3635),不是 MOXA 私有的。這也是它適合當候選的一部分原因:語意由 RFC 定死,不會有「我們對還是 mainline 對」的判斷問題。

## 2. 對應的 .c

**`3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup_net_stdethdb.c`**(43 行,很小)。

## 3. 有 `IES_FLAG_BITS_SET`,兩處

| # | 對象 | flag | mode | delegate 後 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `dot3PauseTable/` `dot3PauseAdminMode` | `IES_FLAG_SNMP_URI_MOD_ON_SET`,並改寫 `mod_uri="etherlike/portTable/"`、`mod_uri_index="dot3Pause"` | **RW** | **完全不受影響** —— RW 在 `mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned()` 第一行就 early return,永遠留本地 |
| 2 | `dot3ControlTable/` `dot3ControlFunctionsSupported` | `IES_FLAG_SNMP_REPLACE_BIT_VALUE` | **RO** | 會被 delegate,in-master 的 flag 處理整段被繞過 |

## 4. 是否影響到 ISS 取值 —— 會繞過,但這個情境已經驗證過了

第 2 筆是唯一需要討論的。`REPLACE_BIT_VALUE` 的作用在 `ies_auto_mibs.c:1713`:把值字串當 hex 字串、每兩個字元還原成一個 byte,再以 `ASN_OCTET_STR` 回傳(BITS 型別的編碼)。OID delegate 出去之後 in-master 不再服務它,這段轉換自然就不會執行 —— 值改由 ISS 自己編碼。

**但這正好有現成先例,不是新風險:**

`ifmibdb` 的 `IfPhysAddress` 是**完全相同的形狀** —— `HANDLER_CAN_RONLY` + `IES_FLAG_SNMP_REPLACE_BIT_VALUE`(`ies_auto_mibs_setup_net_ifmibdb.c:146`)—— 而 `ifmibdb/` 早就在 `agentx_owned.list` 裡、早就 delegate、現在在線上跑。所以「RO entry 帶著 `REPLACE_BIT_VALUE` 被 delegate 給 ISS」是已經驗證過的路徑。

`ifmibdb` 另外三筆有下 flag 的(`ifAdminStatus`、`ifAlias`、`ifLinkUpDownTrapEnable`)全是 RW → 留本地 → flag 照常生效。和 `dot3PauseAdminMode` 的處境一模一樣。兩個群組的 flag 分佈模式是對稱的。

**還有一個細節讓風險更低:** `dot3ControlFunctionsSupported` 本身就帶 `oct_type = IES_URI_SNMP_OCT_STRING_HEX`,而 `ies_auto_mibs.c:1713` 那個條件是 **OR**:

```c
if ( REPLACE_BIT_VALUE || URI_PBMP || IES_URI_SNMP_OCT_STRING_HEX == entry->oct_type )
```

也就是說,對這一筆而言 `REPLACE_BIT_VALUE` 這個 flag **是冗餘的** —— 光靠 `oct_type` 就會走進同一個分支。所以連 in-master 端的行為都不是由那個 flag 決定的,delegate 掉損失的資訊比表面看起來更少。

## 結論

`stdethdb/` 的特殊處理不構成阻礙,而且分佈模式和已驗證的 `ifmibdb/` 對稱。我原本的推薦維持不變。

唯一仍待 DUT 確認的還是那件老事:**ISS 是否真的註冊 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7`**(靜態讀不到,只存在於執行期 Register-PDU)。驗收時除了整棵樹逐字比對,建議特別單獨 get 一次 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.9.1.1.<port>`(`dot3ControlFunctionsSupported`),因為它是唯一「編碼責任從 in-master 換手到 ISS」的欄位 —— 如果哪裡要出錯,會是這一筆。

這份 walk 把我先前標的風險點推翻了,而且揭露了 5 個既有缺口。

## 基線:348 varbinds = 29 欄 × 12 ports

宣告 34 欄,walk 只回 29 欄。**缺的 5 欄全部是 MIB 裡 `MAX-ACCESS read-only` + `STATUS current`** —— 也就是說依 MIB 它們**都應該出現**,沒有一個是 not-accessible 那種「本來就不該回」的情況:

| 缺的 OID | 名稱 | 判讀 |
|---|---|---|
| `.10.7.2.1.1` | `dot3StatsIndex` | 該回卻沒回 |
| `.10.7.2.1.13` | `dot3StatsFrameTooLongs` | 該回卻沒回 |
| `.10.7.2.1.16` | `dot3StatsInternalMacReceiveErrors` | 該回卻沒回 |
| `.10.7.5.1.3` | `dot3CollFrequencies` | 整張 `dot3CollTable` 空 —— 這張是 collision histogram、雙索引表,**零列是合理的**,和上面三個性質不同 |
| `.10.7.9.1.1` | `dot3ControlFunctionsSupported` | 該回卻沒回 |

**最值得注意的一組對比:** `.2.1.13`(FrameTooLongs)和 `.2.1.16`(InternalMacReceiveErrors)這兩個 32-bit 版本缺席,但它們的 **64-bit HC 對應版本 `.11.1.4`、`.11.1.5` 都正常有值**。同一個計數器,窄的沒回、寬的有回 —— 這比較像實作漏掉,不像刻意設計。

(反過來還有個小異常:`.2.1.17` `dot3StatsEtherChipSet` 是 `STATUS deprecated`,卻正常回了 `ccitt.1`。該回的沒回、已廢止的照回。)

## 我先前標的風險已經不成立

`dot3ControlFunctionsSupported`(`.10.7.9.1.1`)—— 我上一則說它是「唯一編碼責任會從 in-master 換手到 ISS 的欄位」、要特別單獨 get —— **它現在根本就沒被回答**。既然本來就是空的,delegate 之後也不可能變更差。那個 `IES_FLAG_SNMP_REPLACE_BIT_VALUE` 的顧慮到此結束。

`stdethdb/` 因此比我原本評估的**更安全**:29 個實際有值的欄位裡,沒有任何一個帶特殊 flag。

## 要不要拿 0805_2335 對照 —— 值得做,但它回答的不是卡關的那題

**它能回答的:** 這 5 個缺口是 NOS 7 mainline 本來就有,還是 Plan E 這邊掉的。如果 mainline 回滿 34 欄而我們只有 29,那是 Plan E 的既有 regression,應該先弄懂再疊 delegation 上去 —— 否則之後出事會分不清是誰造成的。

**它不能回答的:** **誰在服務。** 兩邊 image 顯示的值會一模一樣,不管答的是 in-master 還是 ISS。這正是 handoff 那條 gotcha:「col1 index 對每個 server 都回 row number,無法辨識誰在服務」。

所以卡關的那題還是要另外測。有兩個做法:

**A. 抓 pcap(診斷性強)** —— walk 的同時在 DUT 上:
```sh
tcpdump -i lo -w /tmp/dot3.pcap port 705
```
看 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` 的 GET 有沒有進 ISS 的 AgentX session。外部 :161 看不到 master↔subagent。

**B. 直接做實驗(更快,而且可逆)** —— 因為這個改動只是 target 上 `/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list` 加一行、重啟 snmpd,**不是 code change**。結果是乾淨的二選一:
- ISS 有服務 → walk 仍是 348 筆,逐字不變
- ISS 沒服務 → 29 個 RO 欄全消失,只剩 `.10.7.10.1.1`(`Dot3PauseAdminMode`,唯一的 RW)那 12 筆

拿掉那行再重啟就還原。以這個 case 來說,B 比 A 便宜,而且失敗模式本身就是明確的答案。

我的建議順序:先跑 B(一分鐘、可逆、直接給答案);不論結果如何,再拿 0805_2335 對照那 5 個缺口 —— 那是獨立的一條線索,和 delegation 能不能做無關,但會影響你要不要把 stdethdb 當長期的 pilot。

要我把這份 348 筆基線(29 欄清單 + 5 個缺口)寫進 memory 嗎?之後不論哪一步出現差異,都要靠它比對。

content.text: **ISS 完全沒有註冊 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31`** —— CFA 只註冊那 6 個根。這對現行已上線的 `ifmibdb/` delegation 有影響,讓我量化:

input.command:

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
from collections import Counter
txt=open('net_ifmibdb.h',errors='ignore').read()
c=Counter()
for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\{',txt):
    if '.oid_list' not in b: continue
    o=re.search(r'\.oid_list\s*=\s*\{([^}]*)\}',b).group(1).replace(' ','').split(',')
    md=re.search(r'\.mode\s*=\s*(\w+)',b)
    m='RW' if md and 'RWRITE' in md.group(1) else 'RO'
    root='.'.join(o[:7])
    c[(root,m)]+=1
for (root,m),n in sorted(c.items()):
    iss = "ISS 有註冊" if root=='1.3.6.1.2.1.2' else "**ISS 未註冊**"
    deleg = "→ 會被 delegate" if m=='RO' else "→ 留本地"
    print(f"  {root:22} {m}  {n:3} 筆   {deleg:16} {iss}")
EOF

content.text:
## 直接回答:要,但只要重啟 snmpd,不用重開機

`mox_snmp_load_agentx_owned_list()` 只在 `mox_snmp_init_entry()` 裡呼叫一次(`gAgentXOwnedLoaded` 旗標守著),而 skip 的判斷發生在 `netsnmp_register_*` 執行的當下 —— 也就是 snmpd 載入 in-master dlmod、跑 MIB 註冊的時候。**執行中改檔案完全不會有效果**,一定要讓註冊流程重跑一次。

## 但我上一則的建議要修正 —— 前綴不能用 `stdethdb/`

查 ISS 註冊範圍時發現關鍵限制:

```c
UINT4 stdeth[] = {1,3,6,1,2,1,10,7,2};      // 只到 dot3StatsTable
tSNMP_OID_TYPE stdethOID = {9, stdeth};      // 長度 9
```

**ISS 只註冊 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.2`,不是整棵 `.10.7`。** 如果照我原本說的加 `stdethdb/`,那些 URI 在同一個前綴底下、但 OID 落在 `.10.7.5/9/10/11` 的 RO 欄會被跳過本地註冊、而 ISS 又沒接 → 直接從 walk 消失。具體預測會少 **156 筆**:

| 子樹 | 會消失的 | 筆數 |
|---|---|---|
| `.10.7.9.1.{2,3}` | dot3ControlTable 的兩個 counter | 24 |
| `.10.7.10.1.{2,3,4,5,6}` | dot3PauseTable 的 RO 欄(col 1 是 RW,會留下) | 60 |
| `.10.7.11.1.{1..6}` | dot3HCStatsTable 全部 | 72 |

**改用更精確的前綴 `stdethdb/dot3StatsTable/` 就對齊了** —— 因為比對是單純的 `strncmp` 前綴,而 URI 本來就是分表的(`stdethdb/dot3StatsTable/`、`stdethdb/dot3PauseTable/` …)。這樣只 delegate dot3StatsTable 的 18 個 RO 欄,正好等於 ISS 註冊的範圍,預期 walk 完全不變(180 筆)。

順帶一提:如果 delegate 後 `.10.7.2.1.{1,13,16}` 那三個原本缺的欄位**反而出現了**,那代表 ISS 實作了 in-master 沒實作的欄位 —— 那是好事,但要記錄下來,因為 walk 就不再是「逐字相同」了。

## 一個更該先看的:現行 `ifmibdb/` 可能已經有洞

同樣的檢查套到已上線的先例,結果不太妙:

```c
UINT4 ifmib[] = { 1,3,6,1,2,1,2 };
tSNMP_OID_TYPE ifmibOID = {7, ifmib};        // 只有 .1.3.6.1.2.1.2
```

但 `net_ifmibdb.h` 的內容跨兩棵樹:

| OID 根 | RO | RW | delegate 後 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2` | 22 | 1 | RO 交給 ISS ✓(ISS 有註冊) |
| `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31`(ifXTable) | **18** | 6 | RO 跳過本地 → **但 ISS 沒註冊 `.31`** |

我把 ISS CFA 模組註冊的 6 個根全查過了(`fscfa`/`ifmib`/`stdeth`/`stdmau`/`fstunl`/`fsmptu`),**沒有任何一個涵蓋 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31`**。

所以預測是:現在 DUT 上 `snmpwalk .1.3.6.1.2.1.31` 應該只看得到 6 個 RW 欄,18 個 RO 欄(`ifName`、`ifHCInOctets` 這類)不見了。

**替代解釋**:snmpd 內建的 mibII / IF-MIB 模組可能接手回答了那段,那就沒事。這兩種可能一個 walk 就能分辨:

```sh
snmpwalk -v2c -c public 192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.31
```

看得到 `ifName` / `ifHCInOctets` → 有人接,沒問題;只剩零星幾欄 → 那是 Plan C 已上線的既有缺口,而且它比 stdethdb 這個新實驗重要得多。

**建議順序:先跑這個 `.31` 的 walk**(零風險、不用改任何東西),再決定要不要繼續 stdethdb 的實驗 —— 因為如果先例本身就有洞,那「ISS 註冊範圍 vs URI 前綴粒度不一致」就是這個機制的通則性問題,不是個案,值得先立個規矩(加前綴前必須先查對應的 `tSNMP_OID_TYPE` 長度)。

查清楚了,**我上一則的修正是錯的,原建議 `stdethdb/` 才對**。

## 註冊範圍不看 root 長度,看 `*db.h` 涵蓋的分支

決定性證據就是你剛跑的 `.31`:

- ISS `ifmibOID = {7, {1,3,6,1,2,1,2}}` —— root 只到 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2`
- 但 ISS `ifmibdb.h` 的物件定義涵蓋 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31`
- 而 `.31` walk **完整健康**

所以 `tSNMP_OID_TYPE` 那個 root 只是給 SysORTable 用的標籤,**不是 AgentX 的註冊範圍**。我拿它推論範圍是搞錯了機制,上一則說「要改用 `stdethdb/dot3StatsTable/`」和「加前綴前先查 root 長度」這條規矩都不成立,請忽略。

正確的檢查方式是看 ISS 的 `*db.h` 涵蓋哪些子分支。查下來:

| | ISS `stdethdb.h` 涵蓋 | `net_stdethdb.h` 需要 |
|---|---|---|
| `.10.7.2` dot3StatsTable | ✓ | ✓ |
| `.10.7.5` dot3CollTable | ✓ | ✓ |
| `.10.7.9` dot3ControlTable | ✓ | ✓ |
| `.10.7.10` dot3PauseTable | ✓ | ✓ |
| `.10.7.11` dot3HCStatsTable | ✓ | ✓ |

**五張表全中,一對一吻合。** 用 `stdethdb/` 一行就對了,不會有我上一則預測的那 156 筆消失。

## 實驗建議繼續 —— 現在的證據比開始時更強

三條獨立佐證都指向同一個方向:

1. ISS 有 dot3 全部五個分支的物件定義
2. `RegisterSTDETH()` 在 `cfamain.c:872` 被無條件呼叫,就在 `RegisterIFMIB()` 下一行,同一個 `#ifdef SNMP_2_WANTED`、同一個 CFA task
3. `ifmibdb/` 這個先例已證明機制可用,且涵蓋範圍會超出 root OID

**仍然無法靜態確定的**:ISS 的 get-routine 實際上會不會回值。有 OID 定義、有註冊,不等於實作有填資料。這正是實驗要測的,也是唯一還剩的未知數。

## 步驟與預期

```sh
# DUT 上
vi /etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list     # 在 ifmibdb/ 下面加一行:stdethdb/
systemctl restart snmpd                     # 或該 image 上對應的 unit
snmpwalk -v2c -c public 192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7 > /tmp/dot3.after
```

|---|---|
| 仍是 348 筆、逐字相同 | 成功。ISS 接手,行為不變 → 這個 group 可以正式搬 |
| 筆數變多(`.2.1.1`/`.2.1.13`/`.2.1.16`/`.5.1.3`/`.9.1.1` 出現) | 也是成功,而且 ISS 補上了 in-master 缺的欄位。要記錄,因為驗收基準不再是「逐字相同」 |
| 只剩 12 筆(`.10.7.10.1.1`,唯一的 RW) | ISS 沒實作 get-routine。換候選 |

還原就是把那行拿掉再重啟一次,零風險。

一點提醒:`/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list` 是 `plugin_moxa_snmp/Makefile:61` 裝上去的,所以 DUT 上的手改**下次燒 firmware 就會被蓋掉**。實驗成功後要記得回頭改 repo 裡的 `app/script/agentx_owned.list` 並 commit(那個檔你今天早上才剛用 `f5555f6` 建進版控)。

aiTitle: 實作 ADR-0007 framework 讀取路徑架構

content.text:
實驗成功,而且比預期好 —— 但出現一個必須處理的 regression。

## 結果:348 → 576 varbinds,涵蓋率 29/34 → 33/34 欄

**5 個原本缺的全部補上了**,ISS 的實作比 in-master 完整:

| OID | 欄位 | 變化 |
|---|---|---|
| `.10.7.2.1.1` | `Dot3StatsIndex` | **新增** 12 筆 |
| `.10.7.2.1.13` | `Dot3StatsFrameTooLongs` | **新增** 12 筆 |
| `.10.7.2.1.16` | `Dot3StatsInternalMacReceiveErrors` | **新增** 12 筆 |
| `.10.7.5.1.3` | `Dot3CollFrequencies` | **整張表新增** 192 筆(12 port × 16 collision bucket) |
| `.10.7.9.1.1` | `Dot3ControlFunctionsSupported` | **新增** 12 筆,`Hex-STRING: 00` |

`.10.7.9.1.1` 特別值得記一筆 —— 就是我先前擔心「編碼責任換手」的那一欄。ISS 回的是正常的 1-byte BITS,編碼沒問題,顧慮確認解除。

(`.2.1.17` 從 `ccitt.1` 變成 `OID: .0.1` 只是這次沒載 MIB 的顯示差異,值都是 0.1,不是行為改變。)

## 但少了一欄,而且正好是唯一的 RW

**`.10.7.10.1.1` `Dot3PauseAdminMode` 那 12 筆消失了。**

這違反了機制的設計前提。`mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned()` 第一行就是:

```c
if (entry->mode & HANDLER_CAN_SET) return 0;   /* RW → keep local */
```

RW 根本不會被 skip,in-master 應該仍然註冊著它。但 wire 上它不見了。

最合理的解釋是 **ISS 註冊了整個 `.10.7.10` 子樹並贏過 in-master 的個別註冊**,而 ISS 自己的 dot3PauseTable get-routine 沒實作 col 1。這和 memory 裡「AgentX priority 小的贏」那條一致 —— 更長的前綴不保證贏,priority 才是決定性的。

這條推論還能解釋 `ifmibdb/` 為什麼沒出事:ifXTable 的 RW 欄(`ifAlias`、`ifLinkUpDownTrapEnable` …)在 `.31` walk 裡都在,但那**不代表是 in-master 在回** —— 更可能是 ISS 也實作了那些欄位,所以看不出差別。dot3PauseAdminMode 是第一個「ISS 沒實作、in-master 又被遮蔽」的案例,把問題暴露出來。

**如果這個解釋成立,那 list 檔頭那句註解是錯的:**

> RW columns are NEVER skipped (SET stays on framework).

「不被 skip」講的是**註冊**,不是**誰在 wire 上回答**。ISS 一旦註冊了外層子樹,連 RW 欄都可能被它接走 —— 那 SET 也可能根本沒送到 framework。

## 下一步:先確認 SET 有沒有壞

這是現在最該測的,兩道指令:

```sh
# 1. GET 確認真的不見(而非只是 walk 跳過)
snmpget -v2c -c public 192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1.1

# 2. SET 是否還能動(private community)
snmpset -v2c -c private 192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1.1 i 2
snmpget -v2c -c public  192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1.1
```

三種可能:

| 結果 | 判讀 |
|---|---|
| GET `noSuchObject`、SET 也失敗 | ISS 完全接管該表,RW 欄真的壞了 → **這個機制對「含 RW 欄的表」不安全**,是通則性限制,不是 stdethdb 個案 |
| GET 不通但 SET 成功 | in-master 仍收得到 SET,只是 GET 被遮蔽 → 影響較小,但 MIB 語意上仍不合格(read-write 卻讀不到) |
| GET 其實通(只是 walk 的 GETNEXT 跳過) | 那是 GETNEXT 遍歷問題,性質完全不同 |

同時建議抓一次 pcap 確認 ISS 到底註冊了哪些子樹、priority 多少 —— 這是唯一能直接看到註冊範圍與 priority 的方法,而它現在已經不只是 stdethdb 的問題,而是 `agentx_owned.list` 這個機制的邊界條件:

```sh
tcpdump -i lo -w /tmp/agentx.pcap port 705    # 然後重啟 snmpd,抓 Register-PDU
```

## 我的判斷

**這個實驗的結論是「機制可用,但有一個先前沒被發現的限制」** —— 淨增 228 筆、補齊 5 個缺口是實質收益,但代價是一個 RW 欄。在 SET 那題確認之前,我不建議把 `stdethdb/` 寫進 repo 的 `agentx_owned.list`。

要我現在把這次的三個發現寫進 memory 嗎?(一、ISS 註冊範圍看 `*db.h` 分支涵蓋而非 `tSNMP_OID_TYPE` root 長度 —— 我今天在這裡推論錯過一次;二、RW 不被 skip ≠ RW 不被 ISS 遮蔽;三、stdethdb 的 348/576 兩組基線。)

Base directory for this skill: /home/moxa/.claude/skills/adr

# Architecture Decision Records (ADR)

## When to use

- User asks to write, update, or review an ADR.
- Architectural or cross-module changes (new ownership boundaries, protocol
  paths, shared library contracts, migrate-vs-keep-in-place choices).
- A proposed design would supersede or conflict with an existing ADR.

Default location: `~/mds4xgl3/.adr/` (create the directory if missing).
ADRs are **project-wide** for mds4xgl3, not per-package under `buildroot/dl/`.
Do not commit ADRs into individual package repos (e.g. `lib_moxa_ies_auto_mibs`).

## Mandatory rule (before architectural / cross-module changes)

Before making architectural or cross-module changes:

1. Search `~/mds4xgl3/.adr/` for relevant ADRs.
2. Summarize the applicable decisions and constraints.
3. Ensure the proposed change does not silently violate them.
4. If the change supersedes an existing decision, update its status and
   create a new ADR describing the replacement decision.
5. Do not edit historical ADR content merely to make it match the new design.

## ADR file naming

- Filename: `~/mds4xgl3/.adr/ADR-XXXX-<short-kebab-title>.md`
- `XXXX` is a zero-padded sequence (`0001`, `0002`, …). Next number = max
  existing `ADR-XXXX` + 1. If none exist, start at `0001`.

## Status values

Use one of: `Proposed` | `Accepted` | `Deprecated` | `Superseded by ADR-XXXX`

When superseding: set old ADR Status to `Superseded by ADR-XXXX`; new ADR
Status `Accepted` (or `Proposed` if still under review). Do not rewrite the
old ADR's Context / Decision / Alternatives to match the new design.

## Template (required fields — use verbatim structure)

Every ADR MUST include at least these fields, in this order, as Markdown:

```markdown
# ADR-XXXX: 決策標題

Status:
Date:
Context:
Decision:
Alternatives Considered:
Consequences:
Constraints / Assumptions:
Related Files / Modules:
Related ADRs:
```

Fill each field with concrete prose (not empty). Date = ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`.

### Field emphasis (what matters most for AI)

| Field | Purpose |
|-------|---------|

| **Decision** | 最後決定採用什麼方案。 |
| **Alternatives Considered** | 為何不採用其他方案。 |

Status:
  Proposed（DUT 實測完成 2026-08-06，BUILD_TIME 2026_0730_1302，結果為淨正向；
  尚未寫入 repo 的 `plugin_moxa_snmp/app/script/agentx_owned.list`。
  轉 Accepted 的前提見 Consequences 的「待決項」—— `dot3PauseAdminMode` 是否補一條
  GET-forward rule。）

Date: 2026-08-06

Context:
  Plan C 的 `agentx_owned.list` 機制自導入以來只委派了一個群組（`ifmibdb/`）。
  為了驗證此機制可否推廣，需要挑一個 `iss_build == 1`（ISS 領域）的 MIB group
  作為第二個案例實測。

  候選評估（依 `ies-auto-mibs/net_*.h` 的 RO/RW 分佈與 URI 前綴統計）後選定
  `net_stdethdb.h` / 前綴 `stdethdb/`（EtherLike-MIB dot3，`.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7`），
  理由：
  1. 與已驗證的先例 `ifmibdb/` 同型 —— 同為 ISS 掌握的 switching 層標準 per-port MIB，
     且 `RegisterSTDETH()` 就在 `RegisterIFMIB()` 下一行、同一個 `#ifdef SNMP_2_WANTED`、
     同一個 CFA task（`code/future/cfa2/src/cfamain.c:872`）。
  2. 比先例單純：34 欄中只有 1 欄 RW（`Dot3PauseAdminMode`），先例 ifmibdb 有 7 欄 RW。
     但仍會實際走到 `is_agentx_owned()` 的 RO/RW 分流，不會退化成「全 RO」的假測試。
  3. 標準 MIB（RFC 3635），語意由 RFC 定死，不存在「我們對還是 mainline 對」的判斷問題；
     且 dot3StatsTable 每個 port 一定有值，before/after 比對才有意義。
  4. 五張表（dot3Coll/Control/HCStats/Pause/StatsTable）共用 `stdethdb/` 前綴，list 只加一行。

  委派前的 in-master 基線（DUT 192.168.127.253，12 ports）：
  `snmpwalk .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` = **348 varbinds**，`net_stdethdb.h` 宣告 34 欄只回 29 欄。
  缺的 5 欄依 MIB 全部是 `MAX-ACCESS read-only` + `STATUS current`（即依 MIB 都應該出現）：
  `.2.1.1` Dot3StatsIndex、`.2.1.13` Dot3StatsFrameTooLongs、
  `.2.1.16` Dot3StatsInternalMacReceiveErrors、`.5.1.3` Dot3CollFrequencies（整張表空）、
  `.9.1.1` Dot3ControlFunctionsSupported。

Decision:
  在 `agentx_owned.list` 加入前綴 `stdethdb/`，將該群組的 RO 欄委派給 ISS AgentX subagent。

  依據與實測結果（BUILD_TIME 2026_0730_1302，`/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list`
  手動加行 + 重啟 snmpd）：

  | 項目 | 委派前 | 委派後 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` walk | 348 varbinds | **576 varbinds** |
  | 宣告 34 欄的涵蓋率 | 29/34 | **33/34** |

  ISS 的實作比 in-master 完整，5 個缺口全部補上：
  - `.2.1.1` / `.2.1.13` / `.2.1.16` 各 +12 筆
  - `.5.1.3` dot3CollTable 整張出現 +192 筆（12 port × 16 collision bucket）
  - `.9.1.1` Dot3ControlFunctionsSupported +12 筆，回 `Hex-STRING: 00`（1-byte BITS，編碼正確）

  唯一負向：`.10.7.10.1.1` `Dot3PauseAdminMode`（唯一的 RW 欄）**從 walk 消失（-12 筆）**，
  但**直接 GET 仍正常**（`snmpget .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1.1` = `INTEGER: 1`）。
  即：這是 GETNEXT 遍歷的可見性問題，不是該物件不可讀。

  SET 不受本決策影響：`snmpset ... i 2` 在 Plan E（2026_0730_1302）與 NOS 7 mainline
  對照組（2026_0805_2335）**回完全相同的 `badValue`** —— SET 本來就被 config layer 擋掉，
  是既有狀態，與委派無關。

Alternatives Considered:
  - **改用更精確的前綴 `stdethdb/dot3StatsTable/`**：一度因誤讀 ISS 註冊範圍而提出。
    推論依據是 `stdethOID = {9, {1,3,6,1,2,1,10,7,2}}` 只到 `.10.7.2`，故其餘子樹不會被 ISS 接。
    **此推論已被否決** —— 見 Constraints 第 1 條。ISS `stdethdb.h` 實際涵蓋
    `.10.7.{2,5,9,10,11}` 全部五個分支，與 `net_stdethdb.h` 一對一吻合，用整個
    `stdethdb/` 前綴才正確。
  - **改挑 100% RO 的群組**（`net_mxUnicastRoutingTabledb.h` / `mxunicastroutingtabledb/`，
    6 RO / 0 RW）：更純，但屬 MOXA private OID，ISS 是否服務沒有 ifmibdb 那種現成佐證；
    且全 RO 會繞過 `is_agentx_owned()` 的 RW 早退分支，測不到分流邏輯。
  - **挑 `stdcipdb/` / `mxmacsecdb/` / `mxdhcpsnpdb/` / `mxtrackingdb/`**（皆 100% RO）：
    對應功能預設未啟用、表是空的，before/after 比對沒有鑑別力。
  - **挑大的群組**（`stdrmodb/` 167 筆 62% RO、`stdospdb/` 115 筆 59% RO）：
    RO/RW 交錯過多，不適合作為機制的第二個驗證案例。
  - **維持現狀不推廣**：則 Plan C 永遠只有 `ifmibdb/` 一個樣本，無法判斷該機制是否具備通則性。

Consequences:
  - **正向**：淨增 228 varbinds，補齊 5 個 in-master 未實作的欄位（其中 dot3CollTable 整張）。
    證實 `agentx_owned.list` 機制可推廣到第二個群組，且委派後由 ISS 服務的資料**更完整**。
  - **限制（本 ADR 的主要貢獻）**：`agentx_owned.list` 的 RW 保護只保證「不被 skip、
    仍在 in-master 註冊」，**不保證該 RW 欄在 wire 上仍可被 GETNEXT 走到**。
    一旦 ISS 註冊了外層子樹，walk 會由 ISS 回答該區段，ISS 不枚舉的欄位就會從 walk 消失
    （直接 GET 仍會落到 in-master 較specific的註冊）。
    → 這補上了 ADR-0004 「Design Principle —— agentx_owned.list 與 Plan C 的兩個獨立機制」
      未涵蓋的一面：該段正確描述了**註冊歸屬**，但未描述**GETNEXT 可見性**。
  - **待決項（轉 Accepted 的前提）**：是否為 `dot3PauseAdminMode` 補一條
    `mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]`。強相關證據：ifmibdb 的三個 RW 欄
    （`ifLinkUpDownTrapEnable` / `ifPromiscuousMode` / `ifAlias`）都有 forward rule，
    且在 `.31` walk 中**都看得到**；`dot3PauseAdminMode` 沒有 rule，walk 就看不到。
    該表的註解本身也載明動機為「MIB walk 把 RW 欄與 RO 欄綁進同一個多 varbind GETNEXT」。
    候選規則：col_oid = `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1`，
    probe_oid = `.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.2.1`（`dot3PauseOperMode.1`，RO、委派後由 ISS 擁有、
    與該欄位於同一個 ISS AgentX registration）。
    **此為假說，尚未實測**；「forward rule 是 RW 欄 walk 可見性的成因」目前只有相關性證據。
  - **落地責任**：DUT 上的 `/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list` 是由
    `plugin_moxa_snmp/Makefile:61` 安裝的，手改會在下次燒 firmware 時被覆蓋。
    決定採用後必須回頭改 repo 內的 `plugin_moxa_snmp/app/script/agentx_owned.list` 並 commit。
  - **新的迴歸基線**：`.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` 委派前 348 / 委派後 576 varbinds，
    兩組數字都應保留供日後比對。

Constraints / Assumptions:
  1. **ISS 的 AgentX 註冊範圍看該模組 `*db.h` 涵蓋的 OID 子分支，不是看
     `tSNMP_OID_TYPE ...OID` 的 root 長度。** root 只是 SysORTable 的標籤。
     實證：`ifmibOID = {7, {1,3,6,1,2,1,2}}` 只到 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2`，
     但 ISS `ifmibdb.h` 涵蓋 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31`，而 `.31` 的 walk 完整健康
     （ifName、ifHCInOctets、ifRcvAddressTable 全在，且資料為交換器語意 `Slot1/1`、
     vlan 位於 ifIndex 130/131，非 snmpd 內建 Linux 介面模組所能產生）。
     → 評估任何新前綴前，應查 ISS 對應 `*db.h` 的分支涵蓋，不可用 root 長度推論。
  2. `agentx_owned.list` 只在 `mox_snmp_init_entry()` 內經 `gAgentXOwnedLoaded` 載入一次，
     skip 決定發生於 `netsnmp_register_*` 當下 → **改檔後必須重啟 snmpd**，執行中改檔無效。
  3. 委派的前提是 ISS 確實實作該群組的 get-routine。有 OID 定義與註冊呼叫不等於有回值；
     本案是以實測確認，不是靜態推導。
  4. `iss_build == 1` = ISS 擁有、`iss_build == 0` = framework/config 擁有（沿用 ADR-0004，不變）。
  5. 本 ADR 的所有數字取自 12-port MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS，port 數改變時基線需重取。

Related Files / Modules:
  - `buildroot/dl/plugin_moxa_snmp/app/script/agentx_owned.list` —— 前綴清單本體
    （commit `f5555f6` 才納入版控）；`plugin_moxa_snmp/Makefile:61` 安裝到
    `/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list`
  - `buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c`
    - `:3366-3417` `mox_snmp_load_agentx_owned_list()` / `mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned()`
    - `:3457-3468` `mox_snmp_init_entry()` 內的 skip 迴圈
    - `:3062-3110` `mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]`（RW 欄的 GET-forward 規則表 + 新增方式註解）
  - `buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/net_stdethdb.h` —— 34 筆 entry（33 RO / 1 RW）
  - `buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup_net_stdethdb.c`
    —— 兩處 `IES_FLAG_BITS_SET`：`dot3PauseAdminMode` 的 `URI_MOD_ON_SET`（RW，不受委派影響）、
    `dot3ControlFunctionsSupported` 的 `REPLACE_BIT_VALUE`（RO，委派後由 ISS 編碼；
    註：該 entry 另有 `oct_type = IES_URI_SNMP_OCT_STRING_HEX`，
    `ies_auto_mibs.c:1713` 的條件是 OR，故該 flag 對此欄實為冗餘）
  - `buildroot/dl/snmp_moxa_mib/standard/EtherLike-MIB.mib` —— 權威 MIB（RFC 3635）
  - `buildroot/dl/app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/cfa2/inc/stdethdb.h` —— ISS 端物件定義，
    涵蓋 `.10.7.{2,5,9,10,11}`
  - `buildroot/dl/app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/cfa2/src/stdethwr.c:34` `RegisterSTDETH()`
  - `buildroot/dl/app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/cfa2/src/cfamain.c:872` —— 呼叫點，
    位於 `RegisterIFMIB()` 下一行，同在 `#ifdef SNMP_2_WANTED`

Related ADRs:
  - ADR-0004（Accepted）—— 其「Design Principle：agentx_owned.list 與 Plan C 的兩個獨立機制」
    仍成立；本 ADR **補充**其未涵蓋的 GETNEXT 可見性面向，**不推翻、不變更其狀態**。
  - ADR-0003（Superseded by ADR-0004）—— Plan C GET-forward 的歷史脈絡。
  - ADR-0010（Accepted）—— 「MIB 為權威」；本案沿用該原則，以 EtherLike-MIB 的
    MAX-ACCESS/STATUS 判定「缺的 5 欄依 MIB 本來就該出現」，而非靠 walk 比對猜測。

    決定採用後必須回頭改 repo 內的 `plugin_moxa_snmp/app/script/agentx_owned.list` 並 commit。
  - **新的迴歸基線**：`.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` 委派前 348 / 委派後 576 varbinds，
    兩組數字都應保留供日後比對。

Constraints / Assumptions:
  1. **ISS 的 AgentX 註冊範圍看該模組 `*db.h` 涵蓋的 OID 子分支，不是看
     `tSNMP_OID_TYPE ...OID` 的 root 長度。** root 只是 SysORTable 的標籤。
     實證：`ifmibOID = {7, {1,3,6,1,2,1,2}}` 只到 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2`，
     但 ISS `ifmibdb.h` 涵蓋 `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31`，而 `.31` 的 walk 完整健康
     （ifName、ifHCInOctets、ifRcvAddressTable 全在，且資料為交換器語意 `Slot1/1`、
     vlan 位於 ifIndex 130/131，非 snmpd 內建 Linux 介面模組所能產生）。
     → 評估任何新前綴前，應查 ISS 對應 `*db.h` 的分支涵蓋，不可用 root 長度推論。
  2. `agentx_owned.list` 只在 `mox_snmp_init_entry()` 內經 `gAgentXOwnedLoaded` 載入一次，
     skip 決定發生於 `netsnmp_register_*` 當下 → **改檔後必須重啟 snmpd**，執行中改檔無效。
  3. 委派的前提是 ISS 確實實作該群組的 get-routine。有 OID 定義與註冊呼叫不等於有回值；
     本案是以實測確認，不是靜態推導。
  4. `iss_build == 1` = ISS 擁有、`iss_build == 0` = framework/config 擁有（沿用 ADR-0004，不變）。
  5. 本 ADR 的所有數字取自 12-port MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS，port 數改變時基線需重取。

Related Files / Modules:
  - `buildroot/dl/plugin_moxa_snmp/app/script/agentx_owned.list` —— 前綴清單本體
    （commit `f5555f6` 才納入版控）；`plugin_moxa_snmp/Makefile:61` 安裝到
    `/etc/moxa/netsnmp/agentx_owned.list`
  - `buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c`
    - `:3366-3417` `mox_snmp_load_agentx_owned_list()` / `mox_snmp_entry_is_agentx_owned()`
    - `:3457-3468` `mox_snmp_init_entry()` 內的 skip 迴圈
    - `:3062-3110` `mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]`（RW 欄的 GET-forward 規則表 + 新增方式註解）
  - `buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/net_stdethdb.h` —— 34 筆 entry（33 RO / 1 RW）
  - `buildroot/dl/3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs_setup_net_stdethdb.c`
    —— 兩處 `IES_FLAG_BITS_SET`：`dot3PauseAdminMode` 的 `URI_MOD_ON_SET`（RW，不受委派影響）、
    `dot3ControlFunctionsSupported` 的 `REPLACE_BIT_VALUE`（RO，委派後由 ISS 編碼；
    註：該 entry 另有 `oct_type = IES_URI_SNMP_OCT_STRING_HEX`，
    `ies_auto_mibs.c:1713` 的條件是 OR，故該 flag 對此欄實為冗餘）
  - `buildroot/dl/snmp_moxa_mib/standard/EtherLike-MIB.mib` —— 權威 MIB（RFC 3635）
  - `buildroot/dl/app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/cfa2/inc/stdethdb.h` —— ISS 端物件定義，
    涵蓋 `.10.7.{2,5,9,10,11}`
  - `buildroot/dl/app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/cfa2/src/stdethwr.c:34` `RegisterSTDETH()`
  - `buildroot/dl/app_moxa_iss_10_1_0/code/future/cfa2/src/cfamain.c:872` —— 呼叫點，
    位於 `RegisterIFMIB()` 下一行，同在 `#ifdef SNMP_2_WANTED`

Related ADRs:
  - ADR-0004（Accepted）—— 其「Design Principle：agentx_owned.list 與 Plan C 的兩個獨立機制」
    仍成立；本 ADR **補充**其未涵蓋的 GETNEXT 可見性面向，**不推翻、不變更其狀態**。
  - ADR-0003（Superseded by ADR-0004）—— Plan C GET-forward 的歷史脈絡。

dot3PauseAdminMode 沒 rule 就看不到)—— 相關性證據,尚未實測。

細節見 ADR-0011。相關:[[project-agentx-owned-two-axis-design]]、[[project-agentx-priority-direction-inverted]]

ADR-0011 與 memory 都寫好了。

## ADR-0011 摘要

`~/mds4xgl3/.adr/ADR-0011-plan-c-delegate-stdethdb-to-iss-agentx.md`

**Status 我寫 `Proposed` 而非 `Accepted`**,兩個理由:repo 裡的 `agentx_owned.list` 還沒改(目前只有 DUT 上的手改,下次燒 firmware 就沒了);以及 `dot3PauseAdminMode` 要不要補 forward rule 還沒定。ADR 裡把轉 Accepted 的條件寫明了,你決定後改一行 Status 就行。

內容涵蓋:
- **候選評估**:為什麼是 stdethdb,以及排除 mxUnicastRoutingTabledb / stdcipdb / stdrmodb 的理由

content.text:
三個 repo 都乾淨了(剩下的 untracked 只有 `.gitignore`,不是這次的改動)。

## 1) + 2) forward rule 是什麼、在哪、怎麼運作

**位置**(全在 `3rdparty_net_snmp/ies-auto-mibs/ies_auto_mibs.c`):

| 行號 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| `:3062-3110` | 註解 + `struct mox_iss_get_forward_rule` + `mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]` 規則表 |
| `:3111-3137` | `mox_snmp_entry_iss_get_forward_rule()` —— 用 entry 的 OID 比對規則表 |
| `:3145-3168` | `mox_snmp_forward_get_to_iss()` —— 實際轉送 |
| `:3238` | 呼叫點,包在 `if (MODE_IS_GET(reqinfo->mode))` 裡(涵蓋 GET / GETNEXT / GETBULK) |

**解決的問題**(程式碼註解自己寫的):RW 欄因為要保留 SET 所以留在 in-master 註冊,但它的 GET 走本地 `ies_uri_handle` 的 value-file 路徑**很慢(~600ms)**;而 MIB walk 會把 RW 欄和 RO 欄包進同一個多 varbind GETNEXT,結果一個慢欄位拖垮整張表的 walk。所以**只把 GET 轉給 ISS(快),SET 留本地**。

**核心是 probe 這個技巧。** 每條規則配一對 OID:

- `col_oid` —— 要攔截 GET 的那個 RW 欄
- `probe_oid` —— 一個**只有 ISS 擁有**的 RO instance(已被 `agentx_owned.list` skip 掉),且和該欄位在**同一個 ISS AgentX registration** 裡

為什麼需要 probe?因為 `netsnmp_subtree_find()` 若直接拿那個 RW 欄去查,會查到**本地**的註冊(它本來就註冊在 in-master),找不到 ISS。所以改用一個「只有 ISS 有」的鄰居 OID 去定位,才能拿到 ISS 的 `reginfo`,再把原請求丟給它:

```c
iss_sub = netsnmp_subtree_find(rule->probe_oid, ...);      // 定位 ISS 的 reginfo
if (!iss_sub || !iss_sub->reginfo || !iss_sub->reginfo->handler)
    return -1;                                              // ISS 沒連上 → 呼叫端 fallback 走本地慢路徑
saved_next = request->next;  request->next = NULL;          // 只轉這一筆,不拖整條 chain
netsnmp_call_handlers(iss_sub->reginfo, reqinfo, request);
request->next = saved_next;
```

**目前 4 條規則,全是 ifmibdb 的:**

| col_oid | 欄位 | probe_oid |
|---|---|---|
| `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.7` | `ifAdminStatus` | `.1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.1.1`(`ifIndex.1`) |
| `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.14` | `ifLinkUpDownTrapEnable` | `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.1.1`(`ifName.1`) |
| `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.16` | `ifPromiscuousMode` | 同上 |
| `.1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.18` | `ifAlias` | 同上 |

## 但我要修正上一則的說法

我說「forward rule 是 RW 欄 walk 可見性的成因」—— **讀完實作後這個說法站不住**。

forward 只發生在請求**已經送達 in-master 的 handler 之後**。如果 master 把 GETNEXT 路由給 ISS 的註冊而不是 in-master,in-master 的 handler 根本不會被呼叫,規則也就永遠不會觸發。所以它確定能解釋的是**速度**(註解明載),不是可見性。

我手上只有相關性(ifmibdb 的 RW 欄有 rule 且 walk 看得到;`dot3PauseAdminMode` 沒 rule 且看不到),但至少還有兩個解釋同樣說得通:ISS 自己就實作了 ifXTable 那幾個 RW 欄,所以有沒有 rule 都看得到;而 `.10.7.10.1.1.1` 那個 `INTEGER: 1` 到底是 in-master 還是 ISS 回的,**光看值分不出來**。ADR-0011 裡我已經把它寫成「相關性證據,尚未實測」,沒有寫成結論。

## 怎麼測 —— 建議分兩階段

**階段 A(便宜、先做):先分辨誰在回答。** 不用改任何東西:

```sh
# DUT 上,開著 tcpdump 再從外面 snmpget
tcpdump -i lo -w /tmp/agentx.pcap port 705
snmpget -v2c -c public 192.168.127.253 .1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7.10.1.1.1
```

沒有 AgentX 流量 → in-master 本地回的;有 → ISS 回的。**順便重啟一次 snmpd 把 Register-PDU 抓下來**,那是唯一能直接看到 ISS 註冊了哪些子樹、priority 多少的方法 —— 這個資訊從今天開始已經不只是 stdethdb 的問題,而是 `agentx_owned.list` 機制的邊界條件。

如果 A 顯示 ISS 已經擁有整張 dot3PauseTable,那補 forward rule 可能根本沒意義,階段 B 就不用做了。

**階段 B(要 build):真的加一條規則。** 在 `:3090` 附近加:

```c
static const oid mox_col_dot3pauseadmin[]  = { 1,3,6,1,2,1,10,7,10,1,1 };
static const oid mox_probe_dot3pauseoper[] = { 1,3,6,1,2,1,10,7,10,1,2,1 };
```

再往 `mox_iss_get_forward_rules[]` append 一列。probe 選 `dot3PauseOperMode.1` 是因為它同時滿足三個條件:RO、在 `stdethdb/` 前綴下(委派後歸 ISS)、和目標欄位同屬 ISS 的 dot3PauseTable registration。

**注意這和改 list 不同,是 code change,要 rebuild `3rdparty_net_snmp`**(in-master 側),迴圈重得多。驗收:`.1.3.6.1.2.1.10.7` walk 從 576 → **588**,涵蓋率 33/34 → 34/34。

## 4) swupdate 的方向確認

我跟你確認一下理解一致 —— swupdate **永遠寫你沒開在上面的那一邊**,所以:

- 開在 **0730(Plan E)** 跑 → 寫到 0805 那側 → **毀掉 mainline 對照組** ✗
- 開在 **0805(mainline)** 跑 → 寫到 0730 那側 → 覆蓋舊的 Plan E 開發版 ✓

也就是**每次要燒新的 Plan E build,都要先 `fwr_change.sh Y Y` 切到 0805、重開機、再跑 swupdate**。新版本會落在 0730 那個 slot,0805 對照組永遠保留。

我把這條寫進 `examinate-plan-e-swu` skill 和 memory,讓它變成硬性檢查而不是靠記憶好嗎?那個 skill 目前的規則是「拒絕覆蓋 mainline 對照組」,但沒有寫明「對照組現在在哪一側、所以該從哪一側燒」,正是今天這個具體配置需要補的。

---
name: examinate-plan-e-swu
description: Examine, upload and flash a Plan E .swu firmware image on the Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS DUT. Reports which dual-image partition the update will overwrite before touching anything, refuses to overwrite the mainline control group, scp's the .swu to /tmp, hard-gates on an md5 comparison, then runs swupdate + sync + reboot. Use when the user wants to check a .swu, put a new Plan E build on the device, verify a full image (not a hot-swapped binary), or asks which partition is about to be overwritten.
---

# Examinate Plan E SWU

Full-image firmware verification for the DUT at `192.168.127.253`.

Reach for this only when a hot-swap is not enough — a big change, something
that needs a cold boot, or verifying the shipping image. For one freshly built
binary or `.so`, `~/.claude/skills/dut-console/dut_hotswap.sh` is the default:
under a minute, no reboot, no partition risk.

## Partition policy — read this first

The device is dual-image, and `swupdate` **always writes the partition you are
NOT running**, then flips the boot pointer to it. From `preinstall.sh` inside
the .swu:

| booted on | `root=` | writes kernel | writes rootfs | then `fwrbootpart` → |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| partition 1 | `/dev/sda7` | `/dev/sda3` | `/dev/sda8` | 2 |
| partition 2 | `/dev/sda8` | `/dev/sda2` | `/dev/sda7` | 1 |

The consequence people get backwards: **booting the image you want to keep is
what destroys it.**

On this bench:

- **partition 1 = Plan E** — the development image, the one to overwrite
- **partition 2 = mainline control group** (`2026_0805_2335`) — **must survive**;
  it is the reference for every before/after comparison

So a new Plan E build must be flashed **from partition 2**, not from Plan E
itself. The script defaults to `--protect 2` and refuses to run any destructive
stage while that would overwrite partition 2. Override with `--protect none`
only if the control group is genuinely expendable.

## Usage

```bash
S=~/.claude/skills/examinate-plan-e-swu/swu_examine.sh

# Stage 1 — examine only. Changes nothing. Safe to run any time.
bash $S /tftpboot/FWR_MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS_v7.0_....swu

# Stage 2 — also scp to the DUT /tmp and compare md5 (local vs remote).
bash $S --upload /tftpboot/FWR_....swu

# Stage 3 — also swupdate -i, sync, reboot.
bash $S --flash /tftpboot/FWR_....swu
```

Options: `--host IP` (default `192.168.127.253`), `--protect N|none`
(default `2`), `--keep` (leave `/tmp/<name>.swu` on the device afterwards).

**Always run stage 1 and show the user its output before flashing.** It is the
only step that names the image about to be destroyed, and that is the one
irreversible thing here.

## Full procedure for flashing a new Plan E build

1. Stage 1 from wherever the DUT currently is — read `running` and `will WRITE`.
2. If it refuses (currently booted on Plan E, victim = the control group),
   switch partitions on the DUT as root:
   `printf 'Y\nY\n' | /moxa/fwr_change.sh` — the two `Y`s answer its two
   interactive prompts, they are not arguments. Wait ~40 s for the reboot.
3. From the mainline side, `--flash` the new .swu. It lands on partition 1 and
   `fwrbootpart` flips back to 1.
4. Reboot puts the new Plan E build up. Confirm `BUILD_TIME` changed.

Every stage works from either side. The mainline image on partition 2 was
rebuilt from `2026_0805_2335.swu` and now lands ssh logins in a Linux `/bin/sh`
too, so the script drives it the same way it drives Plan E.

The `moxash` detection in the probe stays as a safety net — an older mainline
image would land there, and the script exits 7 with an explanation instead of
hanging the way a bare `expect` on a `$` prompt would.

## Why the md5 gate exists

`/tmp` on the DUT is a RAM-backed overlay (~505 MiB free). A truncated `.swu`
written to a partition bricks that partition. The script fails hard on an md5
mismatch and refuses to flash.

The device's own `/moxa/upload_my_file.sh` does the same transfer in the other
direction — it `scp`s *from* `moxa@192.168.127.209:/tftpboot/`, which is this
development host. That path needs the host account's password and only *prints*
the md5 without comparing it. This skill pushes instead, using the DUT's
`admin`/`moxa`, and compares automatically. **Do not ask the user for their
workstation password.**

`postinstall.sh` inside the .swu sha256-verifies both written partitions before
flipping `fwrbootpart`, so a bad write leaves the device booting the old image.

Note `/moxa/fwr_update.sh` does **not** exist. The only two scripts under
`/moxa/` are `fwr_change.sh` (partition switch) and `upload_my_file.sh`.

## After flashing

The reboot drops the ssh session; that is expected. Boot takes roughly 40 s.

```bash
bash ~/.claude/skills/dut-console/run.sh "cat /etc/moxa/version/BUILD_TIME" "fw_printenv fwrbootpart"
```

Always confirm `BUILD_TIME` actually changed before starting any measurement —
a silently failed update leaves the old build running and every number
collected afterwards comes from the wrong image.

## Prerequisites

`expect` on the host and ssh reachability to the DUT. Credentials are
`admin`/`moxa`, with `su` (same password) for root; root ssh is blocked by
`PermitRootLogin prohibit-password`. The DUT's sshd stops granting new sessions
after a number of connections — if probes start timing out, reboot the DUT.

if [ "$BOOTPART" = "1" ]; then
    VICTIM=2; NEWKERN="${ROOTDEV%?}3"; NEWROOT="${ROOTDEV%?}8"
else
    VICTIM=1; NEWKERN="${ROOTDEV%?}2"; NEWROOT="${ROOTDEV%?}7"
fi

echo "will WRITE: partition $VICTIM  ($NEWKERN kernel, $NEWROOT rootfs)"
echo "will KEEP : partition $BOOTPART ($BUILD_TIME)"
echo "/tmp free : $((TMPFREE / 1024)) MiB  (need $((SIZE / 1024 / 1024)) MiB)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stage 1c
# The control-group guard. swupdate always writes the partition you are NOT
# running, so booting the image you want to keep is what destroys it.
if [ "$VICTIM" = "$PROTECT" ]; then
    echo
    echo "!! REFUSING: partition $VICTIM is the protected mainline control group."
    echo "!! swupdate writes the partition you are NOT running, so flashing from"
    echo "!! here would overwrite it."
    echo "!!"
    echo "!! To put this build on partition $BOOTPART instead, switch first:"
    echo "!!     printf 'Y\\nY\\n' | /moxa/fwr_change.sh     # on the DUT, as root"
    echo "!! wait for the reboot, then run this script again from there."
    echo "!!"
    echo "!! If you really do mean to overwrite partition $VICTIM, pass --protect none."
    exit 2
fi

if [ "$TMPFREE" -lt $((SIZE / 1024 + 8192)) ]; then
    echo "!! not enough room in /tmp" >&2
    [ "$STAGE" -ge 2 ] && exit 1
fi

[ "$STAGE" -ge 2 ] || { echo; echo "examine only — nothing was changed."; exit 0; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Examine / upload / flash a Plan E .swu firmware image on the DUT.
#
# Three stages, each additive. The default stage is read-only.
#
#   swu_examine.sh <file.swu>              # stage 1: examine only, changes nothing
#   swu_examine.sh --upload <file.swu>     # stage 1 + scp to DUT /tmp + md5 compare
#   swu_examine.sh --flash  <file.swu>     # stage 1 + 2 + swupdate -i, sync, reboot
#
# Options:
#   --host IP        DUT address (default 192.168.127.253)
#   --protect N      partition that must never be overwritten (default 2,
#                    the mainline control group). "--protect none" disables.
#   --keep           do not delete the staged /tmp/<file>.swu after flashing
#
# Why the stages: a truncated .swu written to a partition bricks that
# partition, so the md5 comparison in stage 2 is a hard gate on stage 3.

set -euo pipefail

HOST="192.168.127.253"
USER="admin"
PASS="moxa"
PROTECT="2"      # partition 2 holds the mainline control group image
STAGE=1          # 1=examine 2=upload 3=flash
KEEP=0
SWU=""

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        --host)    HOST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --protect) PROTECT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --upload)  STAGE=2; shift ;;
        --flash)   STAGE=3; shift ;;
        --keep)    KEEP=1; shift ;;
        -h|--help) sed -n '2,20p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
        -*)        echo "unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 1 ;;
        *)         SWU="$1"; shift ;;
    esac
done

[ -n "$SWU" ] || { echo "usage: $0 [--upload|--flash] <file.swu>" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SWU" ] || { echo "no such file: $SWU" >&2; exit 1; }

SWU="$(readlink -f "$SWU")"

name: examinate-plan-e-swu
description: Examine, upload and flash a Plan E .swu firmware image on the Moxa MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS DUT. Reports which dual-image partition the update will overwrite before touching anything, refuses to overwrite the mainline control group, scp's the .swu to /tmp, hard-gates on an md5 comparison, then runs swupdate + sync + reboot. Use when the user wants to check a .swu, put a new Plan E build on the device, verify a full image (not a hot-swapped binary), or asks which partition is about to be overwritten.
---

# Examinate Plan E SWU

Full-image firmware verification for the DUT at `192.168.127.253`.

Reach for this only when a hot-swap is not enough — a big change, something
that needs a cold boot, or verifying the shipping image. For one freshly built
binary or `.so`, `~/.claude/skills/dut-console/dut_hotswap.sh` is the default:
under a minute, no reboot, no partition risk.

## Partition policy — read this first

The device is dual-image, and `swupdate` **always writes the partition you are
NOT running**, then flips the boot pointer to it. From `preinstall.sh` inside
the .swu:

| booted on | `root=` | writes kernel | writes rootfs | then `fwrbootpart` → |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| partition 1 | `/dev/sda7` | `/dev/sda3` | `/dev/sda8` | 2 |
| partition 2 | `/dev/sda8` | `/dev/sda2` | `/dev/sda7` | 1 |

The consequence people get backwards: **booting the image you want to keep is
what destroys it.**

On this bench:

- **partition 1 = Plan E** — the development image, the one to overwrite
- **partition 2 = mainline control group** (`2026_0805_2335`) — **must survive**;
  it is the reference for every before/after comparison

So a new Plan E build must be flashed **from partition 2**, not from Plan E
itself. The script defaults to `--protect 2` and refuses to run any destructive
stage while that would overwrite partition 2. Override with `--protect none`
only if the control group is genuinely expendable.

## Usage

```bash
S=~/.claude/skills/examinate-plan-e-swu/swu_examine.sh

# Stage 1 — examine only. Changes nothing. Safe to run any time.
bash $S /tftpboot/FWR_MDS-G4000-L3-4XGS_v7.0_....swu

# Stage 2 — also scp to the DUT /tmp and compare md5 (local vs remote).
bash $S --upload /tftpboot/FWR_....swu

# Stage 3 — also swupdate -i, sync, reboot.
bash $S --flash /tftpboot/FWR_....swu
```

Options: `--host IP` (default `192.168.127.253`), `--protect N|none`
(default `2`), `--keep` (leave `/tmp/<name>.swu` on the device afterwards).

**Always run stage 1 and show the user its output before flashing.** It is the
only step that names the image about to be destroyed, and that is the one
irreversible thing here.

## Full procedure for flashing a new Plan E build

1. Stage 1 from wherever the DUT currently is — read `running` and `will WRITE`.
2. If it refuses (currently booted on Plan E, victim = the control group),
   switch partitions on the DUT as root:
   `printf 'Y\nY\n' | /moxa/fwr_change.sh` — the two `Y`s answer its two
   interactive prompts, they are not arguments. Wait ~40 s for the reboot.
3. From the mainline side, `--flash` the new .swu. It lands on partition 1 and
   `fwrbootpart` flips back to 1.
4. Reboot puts the new Plan E build up. Confirm `BUILD_TIME` changed.

Every stage works from either side. The mainline image on partition 2 was
rebuilt from `2026_0805_2335.swu` and now lands ssh logins in a Linux `/bin/sh`
too, so the script drives it the same way it drives Plan E.

The `moxash` detection in the probe stays as a safety net — an older mainline
image would land there, and the script exits 7 with an explanation instead of
hanging the way a bare `expect` on a `$` prompt would.

## Why the md5 gate exists

`/tmp` on the DUT is a RAM-backed overlay (~505 MiB free). A truncated `.swu`
written to a partition bricks that partition. The script fails hard on an md5
mismatch and refuses to flash.

The device's own `/moxa/upload_my_file.sh` does the same transfer in the other
direction — it `scp`s *from* `moxa@192.168.127.209:/tftpboot/`, which is this
development host. That path needs the host account's password and only *prints*
the md5 without comparing it. This skill pushes instead, using the DUT's
`admin`/`moxa`, and compares automatically. **Do not ask the user for their
workstation password.**

`postinstall.sh` inside the .swu sha256-verifies both written partitions before
flipping `fwrbootpart`, so a bad write leaves the device booting the old image.

Note `/moxa/fwr_update.sh` does **not** exist. The only two scripts under
`/moxa/` are `fwr_change.sh` (partition switch) and `upload_my_file.sh`.

## After flashing

The reboot drops the ssh session; that is expected. Boot takes roughly 40 s.

```bash
bash ~/.claude/skills/dut-console/run.sh "cat /etc/moxa/version/BUILD_TIME" "fw_printenv fwrbootpart"
```

Always confirm `BUILD_TIME` actually changed before starting any measurement —
a silently failed update leaves the old build running and every number
collected afterwards comes from the wrong image.

## Prerequisites

`expect` on the host and ssh reachability to the DUT. Credentials are
`admin`/`moxa`, with `su` (same password) for root; root ssh is blocked by
`PermitRootLogin prohibit-password`. The DUT's sshd stops granting new sessions
after a number of connections — if probes start timing out, reboot the DUT.

`postinstall.sh` inside the .swu sha256-verifies both written partitions before
flipping `fwrbootpart`, so a bad write leaves the device booting the old image.

Note `/moxa/fwr_update.sh` does **not** exist. The only two scripts under
`/moxa/` are `fwr_change.sh` (partition switch) and `upload_my_file.sh`.

## After flashing

The reboot drops the ssh session; that is expected. Boot takes roughly 40 s.

```bash
bash ~/.claude/skills/dut-console/run.sh "cat /etc/moxa/version/BUILD_TIME" "fw_printenv fwrbootpart"
```

Always confirm `BUILD_TIME` actually changed before starting any measurement —
a silently failed update leaves the old build running and every number
collected afterwards comes from the wrong image.

## Prerequisites

`expect` on the host and ssh reachability to the DUT. Credentials are
`admin`/`moxa`, with `su` (same password) for root; root ssh is blocked by
`PermitRootLogin prohibit-password`. The DUT's sshd stops granting new sessions
after a number of connections — if probes start timing out, reboot the DUT.
